#### Description of the changes in your PR
<!-- While bullet points are the norm in this section, feel free to write free-form text instead of a list -->
- I took some lines off the code where a drawable_image was rendered and made final, even though there were other images rendered from cache.
- I also added a column in the 'streams' table in the database, to accommodate the storage of urls of channel avatar. I used the methods written in ImageStrategy.class to convert List<Image> to String URLs.
- Due to adding a column for the table 'streams' in the database, I had to migrate the database version from DB_VER_7 to DB_VER_8.

issue_context.title: Channel icon on stream details disappear sometimes
issue_context.body:
### Checklist

- [X] I am able to reproduce the bug with the [latest version](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/releases/latest).
- [X] I made sure that there are *no existing issues* - [open](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/issues) or [closed](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed) - which I could contribute my information to.
- [X] I have read the [FAQ](https://newpipe.net/FAQ/) and my problem isn't listed.
- [X] I have taken the time to fill in all the required details. I understand that the bug report will be dismissed otherwise.
- [X] This issue contains only one bug.
- [X] I have read and understood the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/dev/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).

### Affected version

0.25.2

### Steps to reproduce the bug

1. Go to any videos
2. On the video, the icon channel (right next to name channel) disappear

### Expected behavior

The icon channel should show up and not disappear

### Actual behavior

When watching a video, the icon channel disappeared and will show up a generic icon for the channel.

### Screenshots/Screen recordings

![Screenshot_20230807-230436_1](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/assets/141384625/827cbc91-6dd3-4fc5-9154-875005c88522)
![Screenshot_20230807-230443_1](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/assets/141384625/7993a537-a97c-43c0-9a75-3e77edcde7d2)


### Logs

No logs available

### Affected Android/Custom ROM version

Stock Android 11

### Affected device model

Cricket® Splendor

### Additional information

I reset cache on settings, and Newpipe settings but problem still continues.
